name: henneth
description: Compare your brand’s AI visibility, find product catalog issues, and create confirmed follow-up tasks in Henneth.

interface.longDescription:
The layer between LLMs and your brand.

See how AI assistants recommend your brand and products, compare your visibility with competitors, and find product catalog issues using your Henneth workspace in ChatGPT.

Ask Henneth to:
* Review your brand’s visibility by AI engine, topic and market.
* Compare your brand with tracked competitors and identify topics where other brands lead.
* Read the latest AI answers to the prompts you track.
* Find popular products that are out of stock, missing key attributes, or affected by stale feed data.
* Propose a task to address an issue and create it in Henneth after you confirm the details and priority.

Requires an active Henneth account. Connect your account to access only the brands you are authorized to view. Read actions do not change workspace data. Task creation requires your confirmation.

positive.description: Lists the brands the signed-in user can access.
positive.prompt: Which brands can I access in Henneth?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Harbor & Vale (the Henneth Demo Retail workspace) with the user's role. The tool returns brand_id, name and role; it carries no market list.

positive.description: Shows how often AI engines recommend the brand for a tracked topic.
positive.prompt: How is Harbor & Vale doing against competitors for sustainable bedding?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_competitors for the sustainable bedding topic and reports the ranking, mention shares, answer count and date range returned by the tool. Do not assume a fixed ranking. In the October 7, 2026 demo run, Casa Verde Home led at 51.2%, Nordlys Living was second at 44.6%, and Harbor & Vale was third at 43.5% of 168 answers; Brightwell Outfitters and Oakfield & Co followed.

positive.description: Compares the brand with its competitor set and shows where it loses.
positive.prompt: Which topics is Harbor & Vale losing to competitors, and to whom?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_competitors and lists only topics where the returned data puts Harbor & Vale behind a competitor, naming the actual leaders and gaps. Do not assume a fixed winner. In the October 7, 2026 demo run Harbor & Vale trailed in all 11 topics; Casa Verde Home was ahead in all 11 and Nordlys Living in 10. Harbor & Vale ranked second for small-balcony furniture and third in the other 10 topics.

positive.description: Finds popular products with stock or catalog problems.
positive.prompt: Which Harbor & Vale products are popular in AI answers but out of stock or missing key attributes?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the latest Stock Guard findings and the product feed issues, then lists each product with its issue: the three Harbor & Vale lines the engines recommend that are out of stock (Haven Balcony Bistro Set, Coastline Teak Folding Chair, Terra Glazed Ceramic Planter, with the engines that recommend them) and the three bedding products the feed lists without a material (Meadow Linen Duvet Cover, Willow Organic Cotton Sheet Set, Dune Linen Pillowcase Pair), plus the open alerts. Names only products the tools returned. Distinguish confirmed missing material from unverified thread count; do not invent missing attributes or recommendation counts.

positive.description: Creates a fix task in Henneth after user confirmation.
positive.prompt: Create a task to add material and thread count to the bedding products that are missing them.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the three bedding products the feed lists without a material (Meadow Linen Duvet Cover, Willow Organic Cotton Sheet Set, Dune Linen Pillowcase Pair), then calls create_playbook_task with confirmed false. The tool creates nothing and returns a proposal; the assistant shows the proposed title and asks the user to confirm it and to choose a priority (critical, high, medium or low). Only after the user agrees does it call create_playbook_task again with confirmed true and the chosen priority, and report the task title and status planned. No task exists before the user confirms.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Istanbul tomorrow?
Buy a set of linen sheets for me.

negative.description: General writing request that needs no Henneth data.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a garden in spring.

publication.release_notes: First release of Henneth for ChatGPT. Ask how AI agents describe and recommend your brand and products, compare your position against competitors by topic, review the latest model answers for the prompts you track, see open Playbook findings and product feed issues, and queue a task in Henneth after confirming it. Read actions never change anything in your workspace. Requires an active Henneth account.
